## Development Checklist
PR should not be approved until all items are complete. Plan and estimate tasks accordingly:
- [ ] Custom code follows black formatter 
- [ ] Module level documentation is complete
  - [ ] `index.html`
  - [ ] `changelog.md`
  - [ ] `README.md`
  - [ ] `__manifest__.py`
- [ ] Repo/Project Level Documentation is updated
  - `README.md`
- [ ] **After Merge**, Update/Install all changed modules
  - This is a must, otherwise the changes may not get tested
